mapper.select: SELECT D.COM_CD AS "comCd" , M.COM_CD_NM AS "comCdNm" , M.SORT_ORD AS "comCdSortOrd" , D.COM_DTL_CD AS "comDtlCd" , D.COM_DTL_NM AS "comDtlNm" , D.COM_DTL_DESC AS "comDtlDesc" , D.SORT_ORD AS "sortOrd" FROM moa.TB_COM_CD_DTL D JOIN moa.TB_COM_CD M ON M.COM_CD = D.COM_CD WHERE D.USE_YN = 'Y' AND M.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY M.SORT_ORD , D.SORT_ORD , D.COM_DTL_CD

SELECT D.COM_CD AS "comCd" , M.COM_CD_NM AS "comCdNm" , M.SORT_ORD AS "comCdSortOrd" , D.COM_DTL_CD AS "comDtlCd" , D.COM_DTL_NM AS "comDtlNm" , D.COM_DTL_DESC AS "comDtlDesc" , D.SORT_ORD AS "sortOrd" FROM moa.TB_COM_CD_DTL D JOIN moa.TB_COM_CD M ON M.COM_CD = D.COM_CD WHERE D.COM_CD = #{comCd} AND D.COM_DTL_CD = #{comDtlCd} AND D.USE_YN = 'Y' AND M.USE_YN = 'Y'
